features: LARGE 2.07" AMOLED DISPLAY: Maximize visibility with a massive, bright 2.07-inch screen. This everyday smartwatch transitions effortlessly from daily wear to intense workouts, with its lightweight aluminum alloy body and a clean two-button layout.

20-DAY BATTERY LIFE: Say goodbye to nightly charging, with up to 20 days of typical use. This long battery life delivers reliable performance to track your health, fitness, and daily routines without interruption.

4GB ONBOARD STORAGE: Keep your essentials right on your wrist. With ample space for offline maps, this fitness tracker allows you to leave your phone behind and enjoy quick, easy access to your media while you explore.

GPS TRACKING & OFFLINE MAPS: Download free detailed maps from the Zepp App, with turn-by-turn directions and off-track alerts. Backed by 5 satellite systems for fast GPS connection, your route will be tracked with precision.

HYBRID TRAINING IN ZEPP APP: Improve long-term performance with a balanced system of endurance, strength, and recovery. The subscription-free Zepp App acts as your all-in-one hub for training and nutrition, providing actionable insights.

150+ SPORTS MODES & ZEPP COACH: Find dedicated modes for HYROX, strength training, yoga, and more. Adaptive Zepp Coach routines and smart metrics like VO2 Max, Training Load, and Training Effect ensure every workout counts toward your goals.

BUILT-IN WORKOUTS & GEAR TRACKING: Access a comprehensive Training Library to build aerobic rhythm and consistency. Manage your equipment by tracking mileage for running shoes and cycling gear, so you always know when to rotate or replace them.
